scope: Small synthetic functional validation on a real single-host three-replica TiKV cluster; not a SIFT5M-to-10M benchmark

checks: Posting overflow creates new heads and triggers automatic growth
Posting layers change from one to two
Replacement head remains within the configured memory target
Queries continue during insertion and growth without errors
Every retained vector is its exact nearest neighbor
The deleted VID is excluded from search
Enumerated live IDs exactly match the expected set before and after reload
Layer storage prefixes and topology survive save/reload

limitations: The 5M plus five 1M insertion batches have not been tested on TiKV
Large-run startup requires 500 GiB free; approximately 386 GiB was available after cleanup
No SIFT recall or TiKV throughput claim follows from the synthetic functional test
No node-restart, power-loss, or multi-host fault-tolerance test
Earlier fixture attempts were corrected for missing posting overflow and differing local/distributed Count semantics; ordinary regression filters were isolated from the external-cluster suite
One immediate rerun failed port preflight with address already in use; the subsequent clean-cluster attempt passed
